subject: Medford Square Rezoning Historic Protections
overview: The Medford Historic District Commission discussed options to incorporate historic protections into the proposed Medford Square rezoning and reviewed an informal siding proposal for the 16 Whitman Road carriage house project. Consideration of the December meeting minutes was postponed to March.

items.title: Medford Square Rezoning Discussion
items.summary: The Commission discussed strategies to protect historic commercial and institutional properties in the proposed Medford Square rezoning plan, agreeing to attend upcoming joint planning meetings to advocate for historic preservation controls.

items.title: 16 Whitman Road Carriage House Update
items.summary: Ryan Hayward presented an informal update on restoring board and batten siding for the carriage house project at 16 Whitman Road, receiving supportive feedback from the Commission ahead of a formal application next month.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Action on the December meeting minutes was tabled to the March meeting because the draft minutes were not ready for review.
